proposed_rules.trigger: A text node at the very top of the tree (rc1) whose content is a raw JS boot snippet, e.g. starting with document.addEventListener("DOM...
proposed_rules.decision: Exclude entirely from block inventory; source-leak artifact analogous to leaked-css-text-node but for JS.
proposed_rules.rationale: Recurs identically at rc1 on every captured page in this batch; it is boilerplate script text rendered visibly due to a source bug, never content.

proposed_rules.trigger: A [region] node containing FAQ answer text appears a second time as a sibling outside the main content flow (after the footer, e.g. rc4/rc10), duplicating text already nested under an accordion item.
proposed_rules.decision: Treat as a duplicate of the nested accordion answer already captured in the FAQ block; do not add as separate content.
proposed_rules.rationale: The page-tree capture promotes elements rendered outside their DOM parent (e.g. absolutely-positioned accordion panels); this creates a duplicate render of content already represented, an artifact of the capture pipeline, not real page structure.

provenance.evidence: C179 rc2c10 and rc4 both '...' duplicating rc2c8c2c12/13 accordion answers

proposed_rules.trigger: A trailing rc3 zone with fixed text 'The best no-code platform for...' plus a pipe-separated link row, identical in shape/position across pages.
proposed_rules.decision: Model as a sitewide footer fragment, not page content; exclude from per-page block inventory.
proposed_rules.rationale: Identical structure/text recurs at the same position on every page in this batch, indicating global template chrome rather than authored page content.
